newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Baloise sees profit growth continuing.
newsitem.headline: Baloise sees profit growth continuing.

text.p: Baloise Insurance Group said it expected its results in the second half of 1996 to fall short of first half results but added that its financial year as a whole would be very positive.
"A commensurate increase in the annual dividend will enable shareholders to participate in this development," Baloise said in a statement.
It said that profits in the first half rose 14 percent to 109 million francs year-on-year.

Baloise said it expected the rate of profit growth seen in the first half of 1996 to continue for the rest of the year, but added that special factors boosted first half profit, so that the results would likely not match the levels seen in the first half.

"As the first half results include capital gains realized in this period, the financial results for the second half will probably not reach the level reported for the first six months. Nonetheless, the Baloise Insurance Group expectts its financial results for the year as a whole to be very satisfactory," the company said in the statement.
It will release a detailed semi-annual report on October 3, it said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
